source.name: 系统历史雷达拼图 PNG 图像序列

value.physical_unit: none; current pipeline does not invert PNG color to physical dBZ
value.normalization: RGB / 255 -> grayscale; alpha-invalid pixels set to 0
value.missing_time: not imputed; a time gap breaks the sequence and windows never cross it
value.no_echo: not explicitly defined in uploaded source documents; current loader does not invent a special no-echo code
value.inverse_normalization_for_eval: not available in current image-only pipeline because there is no physical dBZ inverse mapping

split.current_implementation: all valid windows are ordered by start time, then assigned 70% train / 20% validation / 10% test
split.source_status: uploaded source documents do not specify a weather-process split rule; this 70/20/10 rule is an implementation convention and should be unified later if the team defines a process-based split

git_and_permission.code: may be version-controlled in the project repository
git_and_permission.raw_radar_png: do not upload to public Git until the data provider/mentor confirms permission
git_and_permission.citation_requirement: pending confirmation from data provider/mentor; uploaded task document explicitly asks this to be verified
